# MindShift Tech — Commercial Digital Marketing Agency

## About MindShift Tech
MindShift Tech is a premier commercial digital marketing and business growth consultancy headquartered in Rawalpindi (Bank Road, Saddar, City Centre). We combine commercial business understanding with high-performance digital execution to generate verified B2B leads, qualified customer inquiries, and sustainable online visibility.

## Core Capabilities
- Meta Ads Management (Facebook & Instagram campaigns optimized for WhatsApp inquiries and lead capture)
- Google Ads Management (High-intent Search, Display, and Call PPC campaigns)
- B2B Lead Generation (High-converting landing pages, inquiry funnels, and CRM bridging)
- Performance Web Development (Sub-second loading, clean semantic HTML, 100/100 Lighthouse speed)
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO & Local Map Pack ranking for Rawalpindi / Islamabad)
- Social Media Management (Brand positioning and commercial B2B audience engagement)
- Closed-Loop Conversion Tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and WhatsApp attribution)
